CloudMD365 trademark filing by Softbir Inc. Key finding: describes product as covering CCM/TCM, DSMT, RPM, eMAR, EHR, and telemedicine. Filed Sept 2020, abandoned Oct 2021. First use May 2018.

Most informative page found. Describes full EMR with behavioral health orientation: pre-admission, CRM, progress notes (SOAP/DAP), ICD-10/DSM-5 coding, treatment plans, eRx, lab interface, utilization review, billing, outcome measures, telehealth.

iVisitDoc homepage — consumer-facing telehealth platform. Pay-per-visit ($29-$49) and membership ($89/year). Covers 30+ conditions across general medicine, mental health, dermatology, nutrition, pediatrics. Powered by Softbir.

Provider FAQ — reveals provider employment model (1099 contractors), malpractice coverage, clinical services (general medicine, mental health, dermatology, nutrition), e-prescribing, medical history intake, no controlled substances.
